title: Text: DET Jerry Lewis ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Happy New Year.  Hope it’s a better year to watch the Tigers
You, too! When would be the best time to do the fantasy camp? I have to make a plan to present to my boss
I think the 2nd week would be best Jan 27. — Feb 3. Have several special guests and 1984’s including Trammell.  Have a Tiger fan at his 47th and 48th Tigers Fantasy Camp
Ok. If that doesn’t work, does the other one work?
Of course. Jan 20-27. Same camp. Trammell there Fri and Sat   With other 84’s.  Play the Philly Fantasy Camp on Wed PM.  Try to make them the same What ever works better for you
Ok, I will let you know. How was the cruise
Wonderful.  Thanks.  Did you enjoy your holiday.  Saw a picture of you and you friend on Twitter.  Very pretty !!!
